info.description: This is the open-source Call to Power and Call to Power 2 server project. This project is not sponsored, maintained or affiliated with Activision.
info.title: Open Call to Power Server

post.description: This endpoint creates a new multiplayer account, protected by a password.

delete.description: This endpoint deletes a player account for the authenticated account owner and invalidates that account's sessions after a successful delete.

get.description: This endpoint gets a multiplayer account's info and requires a valid session.

post.description: This endpoint verifies account credentials and returns a session for future authenticated requests.
This endpoint resets an account password for the authenticated account owner and invalidates the account's other sessions.

put.description: This endpoint updates an account's info for the authenticated account owner.

post.description: When target_account_id is supplied, this endpoint converts an existing joined setup player to AI control. When target_account_id is omitted, the owner creates a server-managed AI account/player slot with the supplied country.
This endpoint creates a new multiplayer game setup record using CTP2-first defaults for omitted setup fields.

delete.description: This endpoint deletes a setup-stage game only for the authenticated game owner.

get.description: This endpoint returns a game's persisted setup fields for any authenticated account that is still joined to the game, including player country and ping values.

post.description: This endpoint lets the authenticated game owner remove a non-owner player from a setup-stage game. Kicked players lose access to game state endpoints immediately.
This endpoint updates a setup-stage game's locked flag only for the authenticated game owner and returns the persisted game state.
This endpoint updates a setup-stage game's name only for the authenticated game owner and returns the persisted game state.
This endpoint lets an authenticated joined player choose a unique country during setup. Duplicate country selections are rejected, and country changes are blocked once the game has started.
This endpoint updates a setup-stage game's public flag only for the authenticated game owner and returns the persisted game state.
This endpoint lets the authenticated game owner start a setup-stage game once it has at least one joined player and any lobby dependency is still available.
This endpoint updates a setup-stage game's exclusions JSON only for the authenticated game owner and returns the persisted game state.

put.description: This endpoint updates mutable setup-stage game fields for the authenticated game owner and returns the persisted game state.

post.description: This endpoint lets an authenticated joined player store a non-negative ping value that is returned in subsequent game responses.
This endpoint updates a setup-stage game's rules JSON only for the authenticated game owner and returns the persisted game state.
This endpoint lets the authenticated game owner update the setup-stage starting gold value before the game starts.
This endpoint lets the authenticated game owner update the setup-stage starting settlers value before the game starts.
This endpoint updates a setup-stage game's style only for the authenticated game owner and returns the persisted game state.
The server derives player identity from session_id and submits one canonical command. Unknown fields and client authority are rejected.

403.description: game membership or controller is not authorized

422.description: invalid command phase or terminal game

get.description: Returns the status of the service.

This endpoint opens a text/event-stream connection for the authenticated account. It joins the account to the lobby when needed, rejects accounts that are already in a different open lobby, returns HTTP 410 Gone for inactive closed lobbies, and emits SSE events named player_connected, player_left, and chat_message with JSON payloads in each data line.
get.summary: Connects to a lobby event stream

post.description: This endpoint creates a new lobby for the authenticated account, makes that account the owner, adds it as the first member, and rejects requests when the account is already in another open lobby.

delete.description: This endpoint deletes a lobby only for the authenticated lobby owner. It enforces ownership before deletion and does not allow non-owners to remove a lobby.

get.description: This endpoint returns a lobby by ID. If the lobby has become inactive, it is closed during the read and the endpoint returns HTTP 410 Gone instead of lobby data.

post.description: This endpoint joins the authenticated account to the requested lobby, rejects the request if the account is already in another open lobby, and returns HTTP 410 Gone when the target lobby has auto-closed from inactivity.

This endpoint removes the authenticated account from its current open lobby. If the owner leaves, ownership transfers to the longest-waiting remaining member, or the lobby is closed if it becomes empty.

This endpoint sends a chat message to the authenticated account's current open lobby, persists the message, emits a chat_message SSE event, returns HTTP 403 if the lobby is muted, and returns HTTP 410 Gone if the lobby has already auto-closed from inactivity.

put.description: This endpoint lets only the authenticated lobby owner update the lobby name, mute state, or public state. If the lobby has already auto-closed from inactivity, the endpoint returns HTTP 410 Gone.

post.description: Create a new session for a user. Expires 12 hours from last interaction.

get.description: Get a session by its ID

delete.description: Delete a session by its ID

get.description: Canonical maps, generation seeds and foreign spawns are private. Use the gameplay events endpoint with X-Gameplay-Resync: current for a viewer-safe snapshot.

400.description: invalid request method, missing game_id, or invalid game_id

403.description: only joined game players may perform this action

404.description: game or persisted world not found

get.description: This endpoint returns the persisted read-only world pollution summary for any authenticated account that is still joined to the started game.

400.description: invalid request method, missing game_id, or invalid game_id

403.description: only joined game players may perform this action

404.description: game or persisted world not found

get.description: This endpoint returns the persisted read-only world ratings summary for any authenticated account that is still joined to the started game.

400.description: invalid request method, missing game_id, or invalid game_id

403.description: only joined game players may perform this action

404.description: game or persisted world not found

get.description: This endpoint is reserved for future CTP1 space-layer support. Authenticated joined players may call it today, but it always returns the fixed 404 JSON placeholder for CTP2 worlds.

400.description: invalid request method, missing game_id, or invalid game_id

403.description: only joined game players may perform this action

404.description: CTP2 placeholder response after auth, membership, and started-game checks

account.Account.description: Structure for representing a player account.

email.description: Email is the email address of the player.

experience_level.description: ExperienceLevel represents the player's experience level (0=beginner, 1=easy, 2=medium, 3=hard, 4=very hard, 5=impossible)

info.description: Info contains additional information about the player.

location.description: Location indicates the player's real-life location.

name.description: Name is the name of the player.

account.AccountParam.description: Structure for representing a player account with non-required fields.

email.description: Email is the email address of the player.

experience_level.description: ExperienceLevel represents the player's experience level (0=beginner, 1=easy, 2=medium, 3=hard, 4=very hard, 5=impossible)

info.description: Info contains additional information about the player.

location.description: Location indicates the player's real-life location.

name.description: Name is the name of the player.

account.LoginAccountResponse.description: Structure for the account login response payload.
